image_description: A low-angle, close-up view of an ornate, baroque-style pipe organ facade. The image features multiple vertical pipes of varying sizes, heavily decorated with gold leaf, floral motifs, and sculptural elements. The pipes appear to be made of metal with a reflective finish, set within a dark, carved wooden structure. The perspective is steep, looking up at the instrument.

The connection points between some of the smaller decorative pipes and the main structure appear slightly ambiguous or fused, lacking clear mechanical joints or shadows that would define separate physical objects.

The curvature of the leftmost pipes seems slightly inconsistent with the rigid cylindrical geometry expected of metal pipes, showing minor warping that could be lens distortion or AI generation artifact.
